part1.title: A Week of Dinners for $40? Let AI Plan It #shorts
part1.description:
Stop deciding dinner at 8 p.m. On Sunday, ask AI for 5 dinners on a budget that reuse ingredients, one shopping list sorted by aisle, and one meal to cook twice and freeze. Check the prices at your store.
An original animated AI tip by zylo.

Follow for one AI trick a day.
